submission.justification: Mixture-G3 with a 2mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.868 ns among all tested configurations. This represents a significant improvement over the other candidate mixtures: 33% better than Mixture-G1 (1.305 ns at 2mm) and 56% better than Mixture-G2 (1.986 ns at 2mm). The 2mm gap provides optimal performance for Mixture-G3, with both smaller (1mm: 0.995 ns) and larger (3mm: 1.021 ns) gaps showing degraded performance. Additional simulations at 1.5mm (0.952 ns) and 2.5mm (0.938 ns) confirmed that 2mm is the optimal gap size. The configuration meets all technical constraints including the HV limit, complies with laboratory environmental and safety policies, and falls within the specified 1-3mm gap range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G3 at 2mm gap achieves 0.868 ns time resolution, which is the best among all tested configurations across all three candidate mixtures and gap sizes.
